scripts.install-all: npm run install-server && npm run install-client
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.start:dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --port 5175 --strictPort
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
